name: Taurox the Brass Bull
canonNotes: A Doombull whose body is turning to living brass, making him almost unstoppable in his rampages.
Driven by a relentless bloodlust; each victory feeds his rage.
voiceNotes: Few words, roaring and furious; destruction is the only answer.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
